sub_limits_waiting_notes: PED 36 months. Specific disease 12 or 24 months. Initial 30-day waiting. Grace period 30 days (15 days monthly mode). Reinstatement of Basic Sum Insured on first claim (free); subsequent reinstatements at premium.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Up to Basic Sum Insured plus accrued cumulative bonus. SI 5L+ has no capping; below 5L has room rent caps removable on +6% premium.
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Reinstatement of basic SI on first claim free; further reinstatements at premium

maternity_coverage.notes: Subject to optional rider availability under variant

organ_donor_expenses.limit_text: Donor hospitalisation expenses covered up to SI

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Road ambulance covered subject to limit

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: Critical Illness sum insured as separate option (in addition to base SI)

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Reinstatement of Basic Sum Insured after first claim (free); subsequent reinstatements at premium. Not available for the same illness within 45 days (relapse)

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Preventive health check-up benefit on renewal subject to SI band

room_rent_capping: No cap for SI Rs.5 Lakhs and above; capping removable for SI below Rs.5L on payment of additional 6% premium
icu_capping: No cap for SI Rs.5 Lakhs and above; sub-limits for SI below Rs.5L (removable on additional premium)
copayment_trigger_notes: Voluntary co-pay options for premium discount per Policy Schedule

worldwide_emergency_cover.notes: Policy period extends by 30 days if insured travels abroad on IFFCO-Tokio travel policy — no overseas hospitalisation cover on health policy itself

notable_exclusions_summary: Individual indemnity plan with 36-month PED, 30-day initial, and tiered 12/24-month specific disease waits. No room-rent cap for SI Rs.5 Lakhs and above; below 5L cap can be removed for +6% premium. Unique reinstatement of basic SI on first claim free. Optional CI rider with separate sum insured. Standard IRDAI permanent exclusions apply.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via IFFCO-Tokio empanelled network and TPA pre-authorisation.
